status: isolated morphology-only exploratory pilot; corrected population metrics; not a production protocol
question: Do the v2 spatial grammar and bounded diversity selection preserve a wider range of actual phenotypes than the v5 neutral lineage under the same morphology-attempt budget?
hypotheses: v2 makes non-spherical mandatory-component shells and spatial branching reachable without a preset phenotype
v6 novelty and bounded MAP-Elites-like donor selection change retained phenotype diversity relative to v6 neutral
none of these morphology measurements imply better numeric prediction

input.kind: one frozen computational genome from a current public production snapshot

conditions.selection: replace only with a previously unseen phenotype
bounded descriptor archive used as a uniform donor pool; no quality score

design.mutation_randomness: counter-derived per attempt from the replicate seed and attempt index; the same random tape is used across conditions
design.map_replacement: random within occupied cells; when full, a new cell evicts a uniformly chosen cell; no best-ever restoration

primary_outcomes: unique phenotype hashes in the active population at the fixed endpoint
distinct morphology descriptor cells represented by the active population at the fixed endpoint
median pairwise Hamming distance between active-population descriptor cells
secondary_outcomes: unique positions, non-spherical mandatory shells, decorative nodes, shape types, branching nodes, spatial span, truncation, morphology fuel, CPU seconds, peak RSS
archive phenotype count and occupied cells reported separately from active-population outcomes
founder diversity and fraction of accepted genotype changes that alter the phenotype
phenotype retention at attempts 64, 128, and 256; no separate stress test is claimed

analysis.direction: descriptive and two-sided; no monotonic improvement target
analysis.effect: paired per-seed differences; report median and bootstrap 95% interval resampling independent seeds
analysis.multiplicity: Holm correction for the three prespecified v6-v5/v6-neutral primary comparisons
analysis.failures: retain timeouts, interpreter errors, and invalid candidates as explicit attempts; no replacement seed
analysis.stopping: 256 attempts for every assigned seed-condition; stop early only for VM safety and preserve partial rows

bounds.environment: existing separate Linux VM, 1 vCPU and 1 GiB configured memory; no production VPS compute

limitations: This is an isolated morphology-only benchmark, not computational organism births or evidence of prediction ability.
A single frozen computational genome limits generalization across architectures.
The archive supports phenotype diversity by design; that is a treatment mechanism, not evidence that MAP-Elites improves computational fitness.
A confirmatory study requires fresh paired seeds and a frozen implementation after this pilot.

correction_history.issue: The initial analysis substituted MAP-Elites archive members for active population members in shared diversity outcomes, making group endpoints incomparable.
correction_history.handling: Preserved as pilot-v1-metric-mixing.sqlite and summary-v1-metric-mixing.json; superseded, not deleted.

correction_history.correction: All primary outcomes are now calculated from the active population for every condition. Archive metrics are reported separately and are not part of the group comparisons.
correction_history.interpretation: Still exploratory; same paired seeds are retained for an implementation-corrected pilot, not a fresh-seed confirmation.
